profile.name: Maged Gadalla
profile.title: Senior Unity & XR Developer
profile.tagline: VR / AR / MR simulations, real-time multiplayer and educational games
profile.about: Unity & XR software engineer with 4+ years of experience designing and shipping interactive simulations, real-time networking systems and multiplayer games. I focus on clean architecture, design patterns and stable performance on standalone headsets such as Meta Quest 2 and Quest 3.

projects.title: VR Space Simulation
projects.summary: Decoupled vehicle control system that separates input execution from locomotion behaviors, enabling several navigation methods in one simulation.

projects.title: Core Gameplay System: Command Pattern + State Machine
projects.summary: Scalable gameplay core built on a custom Command Pattern and hierarchical state machine, with global state management and precise undo/redo.

projects.title: Mixed Reality Voice Interaction
projects.summary: Low-latency, voice-driven Mixed Reality interactions with optimized NLP models for bilingual Arabic and English voice detection.

projects.title: Immersive VR & Educational Games
projects.summary: Full development cycle for VR applications and 2D/3D educational games, with reusable systems and pedagogical scenarios across platforms.

projects.title: Educational Battle Royale (Multiplayer)
projects.summary: Core gameplay and real-time player synchronization for a large multiplayer educational game, with REST API data and Google/Facebook login via OAuth 2.0.

projects.title: Farming Simulation Game
projects.summary: Core architecture for a real-time farming simulation with resource states and time-based mechanics, synced to a backend through a custom API.
